scope: Secondary 19 residual effect source/binary art review only
regeneration_owner: parent task only; regenerate five affected IDs, preserve 14 remaining binaries and all original assets
method: Read secondary.cjs and actual 19 GLB JSON/BIN chunks; inspected float accessors for finiteness.
Opened preserved user airship/observatory references, actual Meshy flame/smoke previews and six latest game-size representative PNGs.
Only added a proven shape-axis correction to secondary Meshy flame instances; no global scale/color changes.
Local primitive AABBs and dimensions below are source/binary evidence, not rendered screen bounds or gameplay meters.

base_evidence.intent: All secondary uses are upward lobes; inner +Z pi/2 maps +X to +Y.

representative_game_capture_evidence.observed_ko: 게임 시점에서 작은 따뜻한 섬광으로 읽히지만 세밀한 붓결은 가까이 보기에서 확인해야 한다.
게임 시점의 연기는 가늘고 작다. 큰 불투명 v1 덩어리보다 가림이 줄지만 밝은 배경 대비가 약하다.
게임 시점에서 표적판 옆 작은 산호/크림 흔적이다. 대표6의 품질검토 기록만으로 잔여 폭발들의 상대크기가 통과한 것은 아니다.
v2는 겹친 다면체 대신 가는 불꽃흐름으로 보이고 세부형태는 가까이보기에서 필요하다.
열린 보호막은 선체 표면가림이 매우 작다. game PNG에서는 밝은선이 약해 식별성 재검토 필요.
산호패치와 세로크림 봉합선이 선체에 보인다. 가는선의 최소가독성을 다른지원효과에 자동적용할 수 없다.

shared_render_handoff.same_camera_scale_time: v1/v2 same camera and common placement_scale 0.32; show both game and effect-close views; use actual airship+weapon GLBs.
expected_outcomes: Upward +Y flame lobes on five corrected effects; parent flutter must not overwrite inner axis correction.
Distinct small/large/airburst/shrapnel silhouettes and attack/support hierarchy at game size.
No unacceptable opaque hull/connection occlusion; thin accents remain legible.
Animated TRS-only and runtime fade versions are inspected separately.
Two loop cycles and explicit state/link stop/reset are checked.
shared_render_handoff.loop_boundary_contract: All secondary roots shrink to 0.001 at 0 and duration, ramping over first/last 2.5% of cycle. Intentional disappearance is a prototype contract, not evidence of a seamless continuous state. Runtime must retain state ownership until explicit end. For salvage use endpoint binder + geometry extraction; disable preview rope scale and boundary fade for held connection.
runtime_features_separate: node extras.runtime_fade requires material/opacity adapter and is not standard GLB material animation
OutlineEffect/cel shading are viewer runtime; maintain OutlineEffect.autoClear=true
Actual collision events alone produce hit effects; no secondary GLB creates impacts or damage
Projectile motion and geometry extraction contract remains unchanged; no secondary projectile replacement here
No independent battle loop or engine integration implemented in this review
